shortDescription: Eldorado Gold NYSE:EGO gains 4.8% in Tuesday's trading as Bank of America double-upgraded shares to Buy from Underperform with a $54 price target, raised from $32, following site visits to the Skouries project and Olympias mine, which were "impressive and gave us confidence in the project achieving…

children: gains 4.8% in Tuesday's trading as Bank of America double-upgraded shares to Buy from Underperform with a $54 price target, raised from $32, following site visits to the Skouries project and Olympias mine, which were "impressive and gave us confidence in the project achieving guidance."
at the Skouries copper-gold asset, Eldorado

has targeted commercial production in Q4 2026 and, based on the site visit, BofA analyst Lawson Winder said the goal appears likely, with upcoming potential catalysts including the imminent connection to grid power and an updated technical report in December.
Skouries is set to drive a 29% increase in Eldorado's
overall gold production in 2027, as well as a 24% reduction in all-in sustaining costs, Winder wrote.
Skouries is a cornerstone asset and Eldorado's
primary gold growth driver, accounting for 32% of BofA's projected net asset value, while Olympias accounts for 9% of total NAV and contributes to growth.
BofA is bullish on copper prices, and Winder noted that Greece has shifted from an anti-mining stance several years ago to support for mining activity, which should enable Eldorado
to help Greece realize its tremendous mining potential.

title: Eldorado Gold double-upgraded to Buy at BofA as Skouries starts concentrate production
